resolved_findings.title: claude kiwi-hot-fix §1.3 note vs §0.10 SSOT + phase-flow role-model contradiction

This no longer over-declares root-cause/정형검사 as current-session. It is now policy-identical to §0.10 SSOT (L34: 정형 검사·까칠 리뷰어=현재 세션 모델 + --model; 시니어 fixer 영향 없음; Sonnet×2 root-cause / TDD=Sonnet 고정). Cross-checked frontmatter(L3 model-neutral 'fixer + 정형 검사 + 까칠 리뷰어' + policy clause), §0.2(L26 '까칠 리뷰어 (현재 세션 모델)'), §1.3 table(L128 header 'Root-cause 사전조사 (Sonnet) | 시니어 fixer (현재 세션 모델) | 정형 검사 (현재 세션 모델) | 까칠 리뷰어 (현재 세션 모델)'), §1.4(L143/144 '(현재 세션 모델)'), §2(L169/170), §5.1(L290 '시니어 fixer (현재 세션 모델; --model 영향 없음)'), §5.3.1(L315), §5.3.2(L328) — all mutually consistent, zero stray Opus, every remaining Sonnet is legitimately root-cause 사전조사. Independently corroborated by Axis A r6 (F-01/F-02/F-03 all RESOLVED, verdict ALL_MATCH).

new_findings.title: claude kiwi-hot-fix §7.1 report 'mode' enum still lists removed --mini modes 'mini|max-mini' (mini-removal tail + cross-variant asymmetry)
new_findings.description: The --mini option is fully removed from this skill (no --mini flag; §1.2 lists --model instead; §1.3 mode matrix has only Normal + --max; state.json mode_flags (L222) lists ['--model?','--max?','--auto?','--dry-run?','--no-sync?'] with no --mini). Yet the §7.1 report YAML 'mode' enum still enumerates the now-impossible values 'mini' and 'max-mini' — modes that could only be emitted when --mini existed. This is (a) an internal contradiction with §1.3 (which no longer defines mini/max-mini modes) and state.json mode_flags, and (b) a cross-variant asymmetry: codex/etc kiwi-hot-fix are abstracted and carry no such enum. The mini-removal automated test does not catch it: MINI_TOKEN=/--mini\b|mini-option/ does not match the bare 'mini' token. This is the ONLY remaining mini-family token across all skills/claude/** files (grep-verified). Pre-existing residue consciously deferred by fix_round5, not introduced by it. Cross-axis corroboration: identical to Axis A r6 F-R6-01 (independently found, LOW/non-blocking).
new_findings.suggested_fix: Change L406 to 'mode: normal|max|dry-run' to drop the impossible 'mini|max-mini' values, matching the removed --mini option and §1.3 mode matrix. Doc-cosmetic; no code/test change required.

new_findings.description: The uncommitted role-model rewrite changed kiwi-coder §0.16 SSOT + §1.3 mode matrix + §2 (2.e/2.f) + §5.2 to '정형 검사·까칠 리뷰 = 현재 세션 모델', but left the frontmatter flow narrative pinning '정형 검사 = Sonnet' and '까칠 리뷰 = Opus'. The SAME description then states the policy clause '검증(정형 검사·까칠 리뷰) 서브에이전트는 현재 세션 모델을 상속' — a direct same-breath self-contradiction on the model of the identical two roles (there is no reading where 정형 검사=Sonnet is correct: even a default Opus session makes it Opus, not Sonnet). §1.4 output labels L178 '(Sonnet 정형)' / L179 '(Opus 까칠)' repeat the stale pin. 'Opus 시니어 구현' (L3), '시니어 코더 (Opus×1)' (L289/L369/L693) are CORRECT — the senior coder stays Opus-fixed per §1.3, unaffected by --model — so only the 정형 검사/까칠 리뷰 tiers are stale. This is the exact F-02/F-03 defect class ('stale Opus/Sonnet names in frontmatter') that fix_round5 treated as must-fix and cleaned in kiwi-hot-fix and kiwi-review-fix-loop, but the same defect persists in kiwi-coder — the declared SSOT precedent. Introduced by this uncommitted work (committed HEAD's frontmatter had a consistent --mini clause; the rewrite replaced the policy clause while preserving the fixed-tier narrative). Not covered by Axis A r6 (whose scope examined hot-fix/review-fix-loop and treated kiwi-coder's §1.3 table as the clean precedent without inspecting its frontmatter narrative). Doc-cosmetic (natural-language skill; no runtime), but a genuine same-document contradiction a reader/agent cannot reconcile.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Genericize the L3 flow to model-neutral role names ('... 시니어 구현 → 정형 검사 → 까칠 리뷰 ...') exactly as hot-fix/review-fix-loop frontmatter were fixed (keeping 'Sonnet×4 병렬 TDD 검증' and 'Opus 시니어 구현', which are correct fixed roles), and drop the tier prefixes from §1.4 L178/L179 → '(정형 검사)' / '(까칠 리뷰)'. Doc-only, no code/test change.
